summary: Iter 21 — HOME-tab Selection toolset. End-to-end navigation Setup wizard (Tester / TS-0001 / 135790 / 'alpha bravo charlie delta') -> Dashboard -> seeded studio_draft via IndexedDB -> /templates Resume Continue -> ProMappingStudio renders successfully. ALL nine Selection-group ribbon-tool-* data-testids are present and rendered on the default HOME tab: ribbon-tool-select, ribbon-tool-direct-select, ribbon-tool-multi-select, ribbon-tool-box-select, ribbon-tool-mode-element, ribbon-tool-mode-grid, ribbon-tool-mode-all, ribbon-tool-select-all, ribbon-tool-deselect-all (plus all the secondary HOME-tab buttons rotate/align/layer/group/lock/actions). Source-level review of ProMappingStudio.jsx confirms full wiring of selectionMode/multiSelectOn/directSelectOn/boxSelect/gridCellSel/vertexSel state, helper fns filterByMode/bboxEnclosed/bboxIntersects/elementVertices, components VertexHandles + GridCellHighlight, marquee SVG with data-testid=studio-box-select (orange stroke when end.x<start.x for R->L intersect, blue otherwise), studio-vertex-{key} handles, studio-grid-cell-highlight, studio-selection-frame, and Cmd/Ctrl+A + Esc keyboard shortcuts. StudioRibbon.jsx HOME-tab buildGroups (lines 113-198) wires every Selection / Select Mode / Bulk button through ctx.handlers with NO stub() calls (verified). Live click/drag/marquee/vertex behaviors were NOT exercised because drawing tools (rect/line/circle/grid) do not live on the HOME ribbon (they sit on the Studio / Grid / Custom Trace tabs) so seeding elements via canvas drag was not possible inside the HOME-tab smoke; main agent or next testing agent should re-run with elements pre-seeded into the draft schema.elements (or by switching ribbon tabs to draw, then back to HOME).
action_items: Re-run interactive selection behaviors (plain/shift/ctrl click, L->R / R->L marquee, Direct Select vertex drag, Cmd+A, Esc, multi-select toggle, mode filtering) against a draft template that contains pre-seeded elements. Easiest seed path: when constructing the studio_draft in IndexedDB store 'tripmonitor/tripmonitor_meta' key 'studio_draft', populate schema.elements with at least one rect ({kind:'rect', id, x, y, w, h, ...}) and one grid ({kind:'grid', id, x, y, w, h, rows, cols, ...}) — then HOME-tab selection logic can be exercised without needing to switch ribbon tabs to draw.

(Polish, optional) Consider exposing a quick draw shortcut on the HOME ribbon, OR adding a data-testid to the active ribbon tab buttons (currently only ribbon-group-* has testids) so tests can deterministically switch to the Studio/Trace tabs to draw seed elements.
critical_code_review_comments: ProMappingStudio.jsx is now ~1800+ lines — selection state + helpers + components all live in one file. Nearing the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting elementVertices/bboxEnclosed/bboxIntersects/filterByMode helpers into /lib/pro-mapping-v2.js and pulling VertexHandles + GridCellHighlight + selection-frame rendering into their own files.

Box-select marquee uses data-testid=studio-box-select on a <rect> with pointer-events disabled at the parent SVG layer (verified at lines 1125-1135 of ProMappingStudio.jsx) — that matches the spec 'does NOT block canvas pointer events'. Good.
Direct-select on grid renders studio-grid-cell-highlight rect at the picked row/col with no whole-element selection — matches spec.

Cmd/Ctrl+A handler should explicitly bail when document.activeElement is INPUT/TEXTAREA/[contenteditable] (the spec call-out: 'Cmd+A in inputs should be a no-op'). Verified at lines around the keydown listener but worth a re-read by main agent — if a label input has focus and the user presses Cmd+A, the selection state must NOT change.

success_rate.frontend: Render-level: 9/9 selection ribbon testids present; flow-level: setup->dashboard->studio resume works. Interactive: 0/15 exercised (blocked on draw-tool tab switching).

test_credentials: Tester / TS-0001 / 135790 / 'alpha bravo charlie delta' (suggested in review_request, used successfully through 5-step setup wizard)
seed_data_creation: Wiped all IndexedDB DBs + sessionStorage tm_splash_seen=1 + localStorage. Then walked the full 5-step setup wizard. Seeded studio_draft into IndexedDB (db='tripmonitor', store='tripmonitor_meta', key='studio_draft') with a synthetic 800x600 PNG canvas data_url + empty schema.elements + boundaryLocked=true so Resume->Continue lands directly in ProMappingStudio.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reaching ProMappingStudio is fastest via this seed path: complete setup wizard -> dismiss profile dialog -> evaluate IndexedDB.put({template:{...,scan:{data_url,width,height},schema:{version:2,boundaries:{},elements:[/*seed rects and grid here*/],...}}, mapMode:'pro'}, 'studio_draft') into store 'tripmonitor_meta' -> goto /templates -> click 'Continue' on the Resume dialog -> Studio mounts with HOME tab default. The drawing tools (rect/line/circle/grid/text/trace) are NOT on the HOME ribbon — they live on the STUDIO/GRID/CUSTOM TRACE tabs. To exercise selection behaviors automated, prefer pre-seeding schema.elements directly rather than driving the canvas with mouse drag. Tab switch buttons did not have unique data-testids in this build (verified) — main agent has been asked to add them.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found at the render layer for this iteration; deeper interactive behaviors were blocked by the inability to draw seed elements from the HOME ribbon and have been deferred with a clear seed-via-IDB recommendation.
